column1: # Arabic (ar) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" forms).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English labels in Modern Standard Arabic,
# using the feature names Arabic-speaking users of vector illustration software know (لوحة رسم,
# عينات ألوان, حد, تعبئة, مسار, نقطة ارتساء, أداة تحديد مباشر, Pathfinder, نقشة, مسبقة, طبقة, تدرج,
# عتامة, قناع قص). No other application's Arabic localisation resource, string table or product UI
# was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Conventions: menu commands are written as verbal nouns or imperatives as Arabic UI style dictates
# (فتح, حفظ, إظهار); key names stay as the menus show shortcuts (Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Esc); product and
# technology names stay in Latin script (VectorCraft, Pathfinder, PDF, RGB, CMYK, CSS, SVG, OpenType).
# Digits are Western (0-9). Catalog rows are stored in logical (typing) order; the labels are put in
# display order when the catalog loads (`LangInfo::rtl`), so nothing here is pre-reversed.
# Coverage: the menus and the most-used panel and dialog strings so far — a growing catalog
# (`complete_menus` is off). Every `ar-*` locale (`ar-SA`, `ar-EG`, `ar-001` …) resolves here.
